evidence.decision_reason: The official FC Online Open API currently documents account, match, ranker, metadata, and image API groups, but no market-wide price-history API. Do not use this source as the Gate 0A price-history source.

The official Data Center UI exposes market-price history and the manually captured PlayerPriceGraph response contains 365 daily observations from 2025-09-30 through 2026-09-29. The current NEXON integrated service terms do not explicitly authorize automated extraction, so this PoC keeps the source manual-only.
